iis_child_dtap_rate.long_name: California CAIR2: DTP vaccination rate among kindergarteners, by county
iis_child_dtap_rate.short_description: Percentage of California kindergarten students up-to-date on DTP vaccines, by county and school year.
iis_child_dtap_rate.long_description: Percentage of kindergarten students enrolled in California schools who are up-to-date on diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis (DTP/DTaP) vaccination, as assessed by the annual California School Immunization Assessment. Data are aggregated from school-level reports to the county level using enrollment-weighted counts. Schools with fewer than 10 students use suppressed data (excluded from aggregation). Data come from the California CHHS Open Data Portal.
iis_child_dtap_rate.statement: In {location}, {value}% of kindergarteners were up-to-date on DTP vaccines.

iis_child_mmr_rate.statement: In {location}, {value}% of kindergarteners had 2+ MMR doses.

ca_cair2_school.name: California School Immunizations in Kindergarten
ca_cair2_school.location: CHHS Open Data Portal - School Immunizations in Kindergarten by Academic Year
ca_cair2_school.description: Annual school-level immunization coverage data for California kindergarteners, collected through the California School Immunization Law Assessment. Schools report the vaccination status of enrolled kindergarteners each October. Data cover DTP, Polio, MMR, Hepatitis B, and Varicella vaccines, as well as exemption status (Personal Belief, Medical Exemption). School-level data are aggregated to the county level using enrollment-weighted counts. Schools with fewer than 10 students are suppressed for privacy. Data from CAIR2 (California Immunization Registry 2) and school assessment records. County-level data are available from the 2013-14 school year onward, released by CDPH via the CHHS Open Data Portal in multi-year bundles.
ca_cair2_school.restrictions: Public domain. California CDPH data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
